interface.shortDescription: Faithful daily and weekly devotional formation
interface.longDescription: Build, plan, revise, and review passage-shaped devotionals with the Story, Worldview, Heart, Way, and Worship & Response rhythm. The plugin keeps research upstream in KV Study Plugin, routes specialist audits to seven bounded Skills, keeps Project-specific reading plans and private permission records outside global plugin knowledge, and routes media, publishing, sermon, and course production to their proper owners.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan a five-day devotional arc from this passage or approved study handoff. Keep the controlling text primary and do not draft the finished devotionals unless I ask you to build them.

name: kv-devotion-plugin
description: Scripture-centered devotional formation from approved passages, study handoffs, and active reading plans, with bounded specialist Skills and clear upstream/downstream routing.
